title: Test Your Halal IQ
note: Demo snapshot of public ifanca.org content, for a training session only. Not an official IFANCA dataset. Content may be out of date. Check ifanca.org for current information.

items: Singapore has the largest population of halal consumers.
Tiramisu, an Italian dessert, is always made with alcoholic brandy.
Halal Cabot Cheese is sold in American grocery stores such as Jewel Osco and Meijer.
Carol’s Cheesecake products are available only in Canada.
Nestle is the largest food company in the world and has almost 75 halal certified units within its global chain of companies.
Britain’s Boots has launched a range of halal baby foods in its retail stores.
All McDonald’s outlets in Malaysia and Singapore are halal certified.
False. Indonesia has the largest population of halal consumers. Singapore with a total population of less than four million has only 16 percent Muslims.
False. Tiramisu can be made using non-alcoholic substitutes.
False. They can also be shipped to both distributors and consumers in the USA.
